hooks.name: Security Reminder for Key Files
hooks.description: Remind to follow security rules when writing to key-related files

action.prompt: If this write operation touches web/server/keyStore.ts, web/server/upload.ts, web/server/download.ts, or src/keys.ts: ensure that key material is never written to disk in high-security mode, buffers are zeroed before release, and retrieveKey() is used instead of direct key.retrieve() calls in route handlers.
